quantity.counting_rule: Public aggregate capability presence only. Exact quantity and subnational disposition are intentionally not asserted.

provenance.method: Safe aggregate operational slice derived from accepted public organization and capability taxonomy records; it does not assert exact count, readiness, or location.

notes: Explicit unknown maintenance state prevents absence from being interpreted as availability.
